long_biography.plain_text:
Kirk Lazarus helped turn a private family retreat in Madikwe into Molori Safari Lodge, reshaping its buildings and choosing furnishings with designer Stephen Falcke. Working with local artisans, he combined antiques and contemporary pieces. The property opened to paying guests in 2008 with just five suites.

Service received the same close attention as the interiors. Lazarus sent employees to leading resorts so they could experience the standards he wanted them to deliver. At his South African retreats, he built staff accommodation and an elementary school for employees’ children. He also offered to contribute to the children’s tuition if they continued into higher education.
